raw_record.question_text:
Read the location distribution map of China's Antarctic Zhongshan Station (69°S, 76°E) and Kunlun Station (80°S, 77°E), the highest point in Antarctica.

<image1>

Approximately how many kilometers is the straight-line distance between Kunlun Station and Zhongshan Station?

method.method_draft: Read the coordinates supplied with the station names: Zhongshan Station is 69°S, 76°E and Kunlun Station is 80°S, 77°E. Use the image to confirm that the stations are nearly on the same longitude, so their straight-line distance can be approximated by the meridional latitude difference. Compute the latitude difference: 80° - 69° = 11°. Convert to distance: 11 × 111 km ≈ 1221 km, so the answer is about 1 220 km.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧为中国中山站位置示意，右侧为中国昆仑站位置示意；结合题干标注，中山站坐标为69°S、76°E，昆仑站坐标为80°S、77°E。图上两站所在经度非常接近，基本可看作位于同一经线附近。
推理：两站纬度差为80°－69°＝11°。同一经线附近纬度每相差1°，地表距离约为111千米，因此距离约为11×111＝1221千米，取近似值约为1220千米。
